emitted_controls.prompt_excerpt: A photographic portrait of one adult woman against an enormous flat anime-style illustration.
Use a portrait frame close to 3:4.
The camera looks strongly upward from below her face, showing the underside of her nose and chin.
At this close distance, the clothed torso projects much wider than the smaller, more distant head.
Her complete crown and face sit high near the center, with a small strip of illustrated backdrop above her hair and her torso filling most of the lower image.
The lower crop ends just below the top hem, showing only a narrow midriff strip and a sliver of the lower waistband.
Her viewer-right sleeve and upper arm cross the right edge; both hands and the legs are outside the frame.
Her chin is lifted and the front of her neck is extended above the chest.
Her face turns a little toward viewer-left relative to the chest.
The shoulder line rises toward viewer-right.
Her eyes look downward toward the low camera.

Her head, hair and torso hide the center of the illustration; its giant smiling mouth is visible above and to viewer-left of her head, with broad drawn hair and clothing fragments surviving beside her silhouette.
The illustrated head is much larger than her head and is cut off by the top edge; the illustration fills the entire exposed background.
Her oval face narrows through the jaw to a tapered chin, with elongated eyes, pronounced upper eyeliner, a narrow projecting nose and softly parted full lips.
Dense blunt bangs cover the forehead while leaving the eyes visible; long straight hair falls along both cheeks and down both sides of the torso to the low crop.
The fitted opaque long-sleeve top follows a broad rounded chest contour that narrows toward the lower torso.
Its low asymmetric neckline leaves the viewer-right shoulder bare while the sleeve stays around the upper arm.
A separate diagonal band crosses the upper chest toward the base of the neck, leaving a triangular opening between the band and the lower neckline.
Keep modest photographic fine-detail softness and softly resolved skin texture, without a glossy wet skin finish; the illustrated backdrop is softer and less detailed than the foreground person.
